mode: AI texture and amateur illustration failure

screenshots.description: Dark UI uses a foggy central light blob as a generic advanced texture with no declared source, material logic, or role.
screenshots.correction: Remove the blob and use a real visual thesis such as product object, image environment, material field, color plane, or functional lighting tied to the scene.

screenshots.description: Repeating dotted/star-field texture is used as fake atmosphere rather than functional data, grid, material, or brand pattern.
screenshots.correction: Remove decorative dot textures unless explicitly requested and justified as functional data, a real grid, a brand pattern, or sourced material texture.

screenshots.description: Amateur botanical-style vector illustration uses unstable geometry and lets stems, arcs, labels, and callout lines cross or cut readable words.
screenshots.correction: Create a shape inventory, layer model, label lanes, callout routes, and collision checks; remove the illustration if it cannot preserve text-safe zones.
